rules.statement: For the frozen VOG replay evidence, MAIN VERSION state is explained by OEMINFO version identity rather than a proven standalone writable verlist partition.
Preserve Board-Service Fastboot while main-version/identity restoration and remaining firmware stages are unresolved.
Stock Fastboot restoration is finalization-only after release conditions are verified.
Branding normalization is distinct from core recovery and must modify only reviewed fields proven incorrect.
Sparse SUPER continuation derives its chunk set from the validated artifact; no universal chunk count is assumed.
